P-ENCLOSURE.evidence: Tall white walls on both sides and a back wall create defined edges, forming a clear enclosed outdoor room.

P-LAYERS.evidence: Only potted shrubs with red flowers and small succulents are present. No trees, no ground cover layer, and no layered structure. Planting is sparse and single-layered.

P-FOCAL.evidence: The bench at the end of the path serves as a clear focal point, with the potted plants and paving leading the eye toward it.
